purpose: Freeze the Sep-26 support expansion plus conservative tight-crop fallback result on the revealed Oct-3 43-tile ordinary whole-hand batch without changing Runtime, the 0.82 identity threshold, V0.10 strategy, Hint Alpha read-only status, or Executor OFF.

policy: Run the current expanded Runtime classification crop first.
Never override an identity already accepted by the primary Runtime path.
Only when the primary identity is UNKNOWN, classify the same trusted geometry component using its tight detector pixel_bbox.
The fallback must independently pass the unchanged 0.82 confidence threshold and the existing identity/source-support gates.
No tile-class-specific override or threshold exception is permitted.

important_negative_control.reason: Using tight crops as the only classifier input reduced coverage and produced high-confidence M3-to-M2 wrong accepts around 0.842-0.844 on the same batch. The primary-first fallback prevents those wrong overrides because the primary M3 identities were already accepted.

interpretation: Source-qualified Sep-26 appearance support plus a primary-first tight-crop fallback closes the revealed Oct-3 43/43 ordinary matched-crop batch with zero wrong accepts and 3/3 complete hands. This is a strong development result, not promotion evidence, because Oct-3 has been inspected repeatedly during development and is no longer a fresh original-match holdout.
next_gate: Acquire a fresh original-match whole-hand batch not used for support or tuning. Re-run the exact primary-first fallback policy and measure exact-hand rate, wrong accepted hands, reject rate, and live capture-to-advice latency before any Runtime wiring.
